exercises.title: Everything under "Điện tử", with its depth
exercises.problemHtml:
The menu "Điện tử" must show every category below it, at any depth. Return id, name, depth for category 13 (Điện tử, depth 0) and all its descendants (children depth 1, grandchildren depth 2, …). Row order does not matter.

Sample database: CT Shop mini (the course's lab project, sliced)

customer       (id PK, email UNIQUE lower-case, full_name, phone NULL, city DEFAULT 'Hà Nội', created_at timestamptz)
category       (id PK, name UNIQUE, parent_id → category.id — NULL = root)       12 rows: 1–4 roots, 5–12 children
product        (id PK, sku UNIQUE, name, category_id → category, price numeric(12,2) > 0, stock int ≥ 0 DEFAULT 0,
                attrs jsonb DEFAULT '{}', is_active boolean DEFAULT true, created_at)          16 rows (ids 1…46, gaps)
orders         (id PK, customer_id → customer, status pending|paid|shipped|cancelled, created_at timestamptz, note)   14 rows
order_item     (order_id → orders ON DELETE CASCADE, product_id → product, qty > 0, unit_price) — PK (order_id, product_id)
payment        (id PK, order_id UNIQUE → orders, amount, method cod|card|momo|bank, paid_at)    one per paid/shipped order
stock_movement (id PK, product_id → product, change ≠ 0, reason import|sale|return|adjust, order_id NULL, created_at)
review         (id PK, product_id → product, customer_id → customer, rating 1–5, body, created_at) — UNIQUE (product_id, customer_id)

Same 8 tables as Labs 1–9 (in schema public instead of shop); the rows are a small slice of the lab data — same category tree, same product ids/SKUs/prices. Every id is GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY: leave it out of INSERT. Times are timestamptz shown in Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh. Full script: the ctshop.sql tab.

This module adds an electronics branch to the category tree:

13 Điện tử (root)
├── 14 Tai nghe
└── 15 Bàn phím & chuột
    ├── 16 Bàn phím cơ
    └── 17 Chuột không dây

Requirements

  • One WITH RECURSIVE query.
  • Anchor: category 13 with depth 0. Recursive member: children of the rows found so far, depth + 1.
  • It must work for ANY depth — no fixed number of self-joins.

Đúng 8 bảng của Lab 1–9 (ở schema public thay vì shop); dữ liệu là một lát nhỏ của dữ liệu lab — cùng cây danh mục, cùng id/SKU/giá sản phẩm. Mọi id là GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY: bỏ cột id khi INSERT. Thời gian là timestamptz hiển thị theo giờ Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh. Script đầy đủ: tab ctshop.sql.

Module này thêm một nhánh điện tử vào cây danh mục:

13 Điện tử (gốc)
├── 14 Tai nghe
└── 15 Bàn phím & chuột
    ├── 16 Bàn phím cơ
    └── 17 Chuột không dây

Yêu cầu

  • Một truy vấn WITH RECURSIVE.
  • Neo: danh mục 13 với depth 0. Phần đệ quy: con của các dòng đã tìm được, depth + 1.
  • Phải đúng với MỌI độ sâu — không nối cứng một số lần.

solutionCodeJson.name: query.sql
solutionCodeJson.code:
WITH RECURSIVE sub AS (
    SELECT id, name, 0 AS depth          -- anchor: where the walk starts
    FROM category
    WHERE id = 13
  UNION ALL
    SELECT c.id, c.name, s.depth + 1     -- recursive member: one level further down
    FROM category c
    JOIN sub s ON c.parent_id = s.id
)
SELECT id, name, depth FROM sub;

exercises.solutionExplanationHtml: PostgreSQL runs the anchor once, then repeats the recursive member on the rows produced by the previous round until a round returns nothing. Each round is one level deeper, so depth + 1 counts levels.
exercises.solutionExplanationHtmlVi: PostgreSQL chạy phần neo một lần, rồi lặp phần đệ quy trên các dòng vòng trước sinh ra cho tới khi một vòng không trả gì. Mỗi vòng sâu thêm một tầng, nên depth + 1 đếm tầng.

SET TimeZone = 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh';
CREATE TABLE customer (
  id          bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  email       text        NOT NULL,
  full_name   text        NOT NULL,
  phone       text,
  city        text        NOT NULL DEFAULT 'Hà Nội',
  created_at  timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  CONSTRAINT customer_email_key   UNIQUE (email),
  CONSTRAINT customer_email_check CHECK (email = lower(email) AND email LIKE '%_@_%.__%')
);
CREATE TABLE category (
  id         int  GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  name       text NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  parent_id  int  REFERENCES category(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
);
CREATE TABLE product (
  id           bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  sku          text          NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  name         text          NOT NULL,
  category_id  int           NOT NULL REFERENCES category(id),
  price        numeric(12,2) NOT NULL CHECK (price > 0),
  stock        int           NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (stock >= 0),
  attrs        jsonb         NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
  is_active    boolean       NOT NULL DEFAULT true,
  created_at   timestamptz   NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);
CREATE TABLE orders (
  id           bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  customer_id  bigint      NOT NULL REFERENCES customer(id),
  status       text        NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending'
               CHECK (status IN ('pending', 'paid', 'shipped', 'cancelled')),
  created_at   timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  note         text
);
CREATE TABLE order_item (
  order_id    bigint        NOT NULL REFERENCES orders(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  product_id  bigint        NOT NULL REFERENCES product(id),
  qty         int           NOT NULL CHECK (qty > 0),
  unit_price  numeric(12,2) NOT NULL CHECK (unit_price > 0),
  PRIMARY KEY (order_id, product_id)
);
CREATE TABLE payment (
  id        bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  order_id  bigint        NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES orders(id),
  amount    numeric(12,2) NOT NULL CHECK (amount > 0),
  method    text          NOT NULL CHECK (method IN ('cod', 'card', 'momo', 'bank')),
  paid_at   timestamptz   NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);
CREATE TABLE stock_movement (
  id          bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  product_id  bigint      NOT NULL REFERENCES product(id),
  change      int         NOT NULL CHECK (change <> 0),
  reason      text        NOT NULL CHECK (reason IN ('import', 'sale', 'return', 'adjust')),
  order_id    bigint      REFERENCES orders(id),
  created_at  timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);
CREATE TABLE review (
  id           bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  product_id   bigint      NOT NULL REFERENCES product(id),
  customer_id  bigint      NOT NULL REFERENCES customer(id),
  rating       smallint    NOT NULL CHECK (rating BETWEEN 1 AND 5),
  body         text,
  created_at   timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  UNIQUE (product_id, customer_id)
);

Every product page shows a breadcrumb such as Điện tử > Bàn phím & chuột > Bàn phím cơ. Return id, path for every category, where path is the chain of names from its root down to it, joined by " > ". Order by id.

product        (id PK, sku UNIQUE, name, category_id → category, price numeric(12,2) > 0, stock int ≥ 0 DEFAULT 0,
                attrs jsonb DEFAULT '{}', is_active boolean DEFAULT true, created_at)          16 rows (ids 1…46, gaps)

SET TimeZone = 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh';
CREATE TABLE customer (
  id          bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  email       text        NOT NULL,
  full_name   text        NOT NULL,
  phone       text,
  city        text        NOT NULL DEFAULT 'Hà Nội',
  created_at  timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  CONSTRAINT customer_email_key   UNIQUE (email),
  CONSTRAINT customer_email_check CHECK (email = lower(email) AND email LIKE '%_@_%.__%')
);
CREATE TABLE category (
  id         int  GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  name       text NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  parent_id  int  REFERENCES category(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
);
CREATE TABLE product (
  id           bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  sku          text          NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  name         text          NOT NULL,
  category_id  int           NOT NULL REFERENCES category(id),
  price        numeric(12,2) NOT NULL CHECK (price > 0),
  stock        int           NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (stock >= 0),
  attrs        jsonb         NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
  is_active    boolean       NOT NULL DEFAULT true,
  created_at   timestamptz   NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);
CREATE TABLE orders (
  id           bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  customer_id  bigint      NOT NULL REFERENCES customer(id),
  status       text        NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending'
               CHECK (status IN ('pending', 'paid', 'shipped', 'cancelled')),
  created_at   timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  note         text
);
CREATE TABLE order_item (
  order_id    bigint        NOT NULL REFERENCES orders(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  product_id  bigint        NOT NULL REFERENCES product(id),
  qty         int           NOT NULL CHECK (qty > 0),
  unit_price  numeric(12,2) NOT NULL CHECK (unit_price > 0),
  PRIMARY KEY (order_id, product_id)
);
CREATE TABLE payment (
  id        bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  order_id  bigint        NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES orders(id),
  amount    numeric(12,2) NOT NULL CHECK (amount > 0),
  method    text          NOT NULL CHECK (method IN ('cod', 'card', 'momo', 'bank')),
  paid_at   timestamptz   NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);
CREATE TABLE stock_movement (
  id          bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  product_id  bigint      NOT NULL REFERENCES product(id),
  change      int         NOT NULL CHECK (change <> 0),
  reason      text        NOT NULL CHECK (reason IN ('import', 'sale', 'return', 'adjust')),
  order_id    bigint      REFERENCES orders(id),
  created_at  timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);
CREATE TABLE review (
  id           bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  product_id   bigint      NOT NULL REFERENCES product(id),
  customer_id  bigint      NOT NULL REFERENCES customer(id),
  rating       smallint    NOT NULL CHECK (rating BETWEEN 1 AND 5),
  body         text,
  created_at   timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  UNIQUE (product_id, customer_id)
);

solutionCodeJson.code:
WITH RECURSIVE tree AS (
    SELECT id, name::text AS path
    FROM category
    WHERE parent_id IS NULL
  UNION ALL
    SELECT c.id, t.path || ' > ' || c.name
    FROM category c
    JOIN tree t ON c.parent_id = t.id

exercises.title: Walk a tree that contains a cycle
exercises.problemHtml:
A data bug created a cycle 15 → 16 → 15. A naive walk down from Bàn phím & chuột (15) never stops (the grader kills it after 4 s). Return id, name, depth of category 15 (depth 0) and everything reachable below it, each category once, stopping when the walk comes back to a category it already visited. Use PostgreSQL's CYCLE clause.

Sample database: CT Shop mini (the course's lab project, sliced)

customer       (id PK, email UNIQUE lower-case, full_name, phone NULL, city DEFAULT 'Hà Nội', created_at timestamptz)
category       (id PK, name UNIQUE, parent_id → category.id — NULL = root)       12 rows: 1–4 roots, 5–12 children
product        (id PK, sku UNIQUE, name, category_id → category, price numeric(12,2) > 0, stock int ≥ 0 DEFAULT 0,
                attrs jsonb DEFAULT '{}', is_active boolean DEFAULT true, created_at)          16 rows (ids 1…46, gaps)
orders         (id PK, customer_id → customer, status pending|paid|shipped|cancelled, created_at timestamptz, note)   14 rows
order_item     (order_id → orders ON DELETE CASCADE, product_id → product, qty > 0, unit_price) — PK (order_id, product_id)
payment        (id PK, order_id UNIQUE → orders, amount, method cod|card|momo|bank, paid_at)    one per paid/shipped order
stock_movement (id PK, product_id → product, change ≠ 0, reason import|sale|return|adjust, order_id NULL, created_at)
review         (id PK, product_id → product, customer_id → customer, rating 1–5, body, created_at) — UNIQUE (product_id, customer_id)

Same 8 tables as Labs 1–9 (in schema public instead of shop); the rows are a small slice of the lab data — same category tree, same product ids/SKUs/prices. Every id is GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY: leave it out of INSERT. Times are timestamptz shown in Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh. Full script: the ctshop.sql tab.

This module adds an electronics branch to the category tree:

13 Điện tử (root)
├── 14 Tai nghe
└── 15 Bàn phím & chuột
    ├── 16 Bàn phím cơ
    └── 17 Chuột không dây

Data bug in this task: category 15 now points to 16 as its parent, and 16 points to 15 — a cycle.

Requirements

  • WITH RECURSIVE … ( … ) CYCLE id SET is_cycle USING path.
  • Keep only the rows where NOT is_cycle.

Module này thêm một nhánh điện tử vào cây danh mục:

├── 14 Tai nghe

-- Plain PostgreSQL: run it as-is in psql to get the same database on your machine.
SET TimeZone = 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh';
CREATE TABLE customer (
  id          bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  email       text        NOT NULL,
  full_name   text        NOT NULL,
  phone       text,
  city        text        NOT NULL DEFAULT 'Hà Nội',
  created_at  timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  CONSTRAINT customer_email_key   UNIQUE (email),
  CONSTRAINT customer_email_check CHECK (email = lower(email) AND email LIKE '%_@_%.__%')
);
CREATE TABLE category (
  id         int  GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  name       text NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  parent_id  int  REFERENCES category(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
);
CREATE TABLE product (
  id           bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  sku          text          NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  name         text          NOT NULL,
  category_id  int           NOT NULL REFERENCES category(id),
  price        numeric(12,2) NOT NULL CHECK (price > 0),
  stock        int           NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (stock >= 0),
  attrs        jsonb         NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
  is_active    boolean       NOT NULL DEFAULT true,
  created_at   timestamptz   NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);
CREATE TABLE orders (
  id           bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  customer_id  bigint      NOT NULL REFERENCES customer(id),
  status       text        NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending'
               CHECK (status IN ('pending', 'paid', 'shipped', 'cancelled')),
  created_at   timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  note         text
);
CREATE TABLE order_item (
  order_id    bigint        NOT NULL REFERENCES orders(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  product_id  bigint        NOT NULL REFERENCES product(id),
  qty         int           NOT NULL CHECK (qty > 0),
  unit_price  numeric(12,2) NOT NULL CHECK (unit_price > 0),
  PRIMARY KEY (order_id, product_id)
);
CREATE TABLE payment (
  id        bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  order_id  bigint        NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES orders(id),
  amount    numeric(12,2) NOT NULL CHECK (amount > 0),
  method    text          NOT NULL CHECK (method IN ('cod', 'card', 'momo', 'bank')),
  paid_at   timestamptz   NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);
CREATE TABLE stock_movement (
  id          bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  product_id  bigint      NOT NULL REFERENCES product(id),
  change      int         NOT NULL CHECK (change <> 0),
  reason      text        NOT NULL CHECK (reason IN ('import', 'sale', 'return', 'adjust')),
  order_id    bigint      REFERENCES orders(id),
  created_at  timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);
CREATE TABLE review (
  id           bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  product_id   bigint      NOT NULL REFERENCES product(id),
  customer_id  bigint      NOT NULL REFERENCES customer(id),
  rating       smallint    NOT NULL CHECK (rating BETWEEN 1 AND 5),
  body         text,
  created_at   timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  UNIQUE (product_id, customer_id)
);

WITH RECURSIVE sub AS (
    SELECT id, name, 0 AS depth
    FROM category
    WHERE id = 15
  UNION ALL
    SELECT c.id, c.name, s.depth + 1
    FROM category c
    JOIN sub s ON c.parent_id = s.id
) CYCLE id SET is_cycle USING path      -- marks a row whose id is already on its path, and stops there
SELECT id, name, depth
FROM sub
WHERE NOT is_cycle;

exercises.title: Products under each root, at any depth
exercises.problemHtml:
The category page of each root shows how many active products live anywhere below it. Return root_id, root, products for every root (0 when none), ordered by root_id.

Sample database: CT Shop mini (the course's lab project, sliced)

customer       (id PK, email UNIQUE lower-case, full_name, phone NULL, city DEFAULT 'Hà Nội', created_at timestamptz)
category       (id PK, name UNIQUE, parent_id → category.id — NULL = root)       12 rows: 1–4 roots, 5–12 children
product        (id PK, sku UNIQUE, name, category_id → category, price numeric(12,2) > 0, stock int ≥ 0 DEFAULT 0,
                attrs jsonb DEFAULT '{}', is_active boolean DEFAULT true, created_at)          16 rows (ids 1…46, gaps)
orders         (id PK, customer_id → customer, status pending|paid|shipped|cancelled, created_at timestamptz, note)   14 rows
order_item     (order_id → orders ON DELETE CASCADE, product_id → product, qty > 0, unit_price) — PK (order_id, product_id)
payment        (id PK, order_id UNIQUE → orders, amount, method cod|card|momo|bank, paid_at)    one per paid/shipped order
stock_movement (id PK, product_id → product, change ≠ 0, reason import|sale|return|adjust, order_id NULL, created_at)
review         (id PK, product_id → product, customer_id → customer, rating 1–5, body, created_at) — UNIQUE (product_id, customer_id)

Same 8 tables as Labs 1–9 (in schema public instead of shop); the rows are a small slice of the lab data — same category tree, same product ids/SKUs/prices. Every id is GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY: leave it out of INSERT. Times are timestamptz shown in Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh. Full script: the ctshop.sql tab.

This module adds an electronics branch to the category tree:

13 Điện tử (root)
├── 14 Tai nghe
└── 15 Bàn phím & chuột
    ├── 16 Bàn phím cơ
    └── 17 Chuột không dây

Requirements

  • The recursion carries the root id down: anchor SELECT id, id AS root_id …, recursive member keeps t.root_id.
  • LEFT JOIN products so an empty root shows 0.

-- Plain PostgreSQL: run it as-is in psql to get the same database on your machine.
SET TimeZone = 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh';
CREATE TABLE customer (
  id          bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  email       text        NOT NULL,
  full_name   text        NOT NULL,
  phone       text,
  city        text        NOT NULL DEFAULT 'Hà Nội',
  created_at  timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  CONSTRAINT customer_email_key   UNIQUE (email),
  CONSTRAINT customer_email_check CHECK (email = lower(email) AND email LIKE '%_@_%.__%')
);
CREATE TABLE category (
  id         int  GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  name       text NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  parent_id  int  REFERENCES category(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
);
CREATE TABLE product (
  id           bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  sku          text          NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  name         text          NOT NULL,
  category_id  int           NOT NULL REFERENCES category(id),
  price        numeric(12,2) NOT NULL CHECK (price > 0),
  stock        int           NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (stock >= 0),
  attrs        jsonb         NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
  is_active    boolean       NOT NULL DEFAULT true,
  created_at   timestamptz   NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);
CREATE TABLE orders (
  id           bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  customer_id  bigint      NOT NULL REFERENCES customer(id),
  status       text        NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending'
               CHECK (status IN ('pending', 'paid', 'shipped', 'cancelled')),
  created_at   timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  note         text
);
CREATE TABLE order_item (
  order_id    bigint        NOT NULL REFERENCES orders(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  product_id  bigint        NOT NULL REFERENCES product(id),
  qty         int           NOT NULL CHECK (qty > 0),
  unit_price  numeric(12,2) NOT NULL CHECK (unit_price > 0),
  PRIMARY KEY (order_id, product_id)
);
CREATE TABLE payment (
  id        bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  order_id  bigint        NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES orders(id),
  amount    numeric(12,2) NOT NULL CHECK (amount > 0),
  method    text          NOT NULL CHECK (method IN ('cod', 'card', 'momo', 'bank')),
  paid_at   timestamptz   NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);
CREATE TABLE stock_movement (
  id          bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  product_id  bigint      NOT NULL REFERENCES product(id),
  change      int         NOT NULL CHECK (change <> 0),
  reason      text        NOT NULL CHECK (reason IN ('import', 'sale', 'return', 'adjust')),
  order_id    bigint      REFERENCES orders(id),
  created_at  timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);
CREATE TABLE review (
  id           bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  product_id   bigint      NOT NULL REFERENCES product(id),
  customer_id  bigint      NOT NULL REFERENCES customer(id),
  rating       smallint    NOT NULL CHECK (rating BETWEEN 1 AND 5),
  body         text,
  created_at   timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  UNIQUE (product_id, customer_id)
);

WITH RECURSIVE tree AS (
    SELECT id, id AS root_id                 -- every root is its own root
    FROM category WHERE parent_id IS NULL
  UNION ALL
    SELECT c.id, t.root_id                   -- children inherit the root of their parent
    FROM category c JOIN tree t ON c.parent_id = t.id
)
SELECT r.id AS root_id, r.name AS root,
       count(p.id) AS products
FROM category r
JOIN tree t           ON t.root_id = r.id
LEFT JOIN product p   ON p.category_id = t.id AND p.is_active
WHERE r.parent_id IS NULL
GROUP BY r.id, r.name
ORDER BY r.id;

CREATE TABLE customer (

  created_at  timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  CONSTRAINT customer_email_key   UNIQUE (email),
  CONSTRAINT customer_email_check CHECK (email = lower(email) AND email LIKE '%_@_%.__%')
);
CREATE TABLE category (
  id         int  GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  name       text NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  parent_id  int  REFERENCES category(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
);
CREATE TABLE product (
  id           bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  sku          text          NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  name         text          NOT NULL,
  category_id  int           NOT NULL REFERENCES category(id),
  price        numeric(12,2) NOT NULL CHECK (price > 0),
  stock        int           NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (stock >= 0),
  attrs        jsonb         NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
  is_active    boolean       NOT NULL DEFAULT true,
  created_at   timestamptz   NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);
CREATE TABLE orders (
  id           bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  customer_id  bigint      NOT NULL REFERENCES customer(id),
  status       text        NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending'
               CHECK (status IN ('pending', 'paid', 'shipped', 'cancelled')),
  created_at   timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  note         text
);
CREATE TABLE order_item (
  order_id    bigint        NOT NULL REFERENCES orders(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  product_id  bigint        NOT NULL REFERENCES product(id),
  qty         int           NOT NULL CHECK (qty > 0),
  unit_price  numeric(12,2) NOT NULL CHECK (unit_price > 0),
  PRIMARY KEY (order_id, product_id)
);
CREATE TABLE payment (
  id        bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  order_id  bigint        NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES orders(id),
  amount    numeric(12,2) NOT NULL CHECK (amount > 0),
  method    text          NOT NULL CHECK (method IN ('cod', 'card', 'momo', 'bank')),
  paid_at   timestamptz   NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);
CREATE TABLE stock_movement (
  id          bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  product_id  bigint      NOT NULL REFERENCES product(id),
  change      int         NOT NULL CHECK (change <> 0),
  reason      text        NOT NULL CHECK (reason IN ('import', 'sale', 'return', 'adjust')),
  order_id    bigint      REFERENCES orders(id),
  created_at  timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);
CREATE TABLE review (
  id           bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  product_id   bigint      NOT NULL REFERENCES product(id),
  customer_id  bigint      NOT NULL REFERENCES customer(id),
  rating       smallint    NOT NULL CHECK (rating BETWEEN 1 AND 5),
  body         text,
  created_at   timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  UNIQUE (product_id, customer_id)
);

  name       text NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  parent_id  int  REFERENCES category(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
);
CREATE TABLE product (
  id           bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  sku          text          NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  name         text          NOT NULL,
  category_id  int           NOT NULL REFERENCES category(id),
  price        numeric(12,2) NOT NULL CHECK (price > 0),
  stock        int           NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (stock >= 0),
  attrs        jsonb         NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
  is_active    boolean       NOT NULL DEFAULT true,
  created_at   timestamptz   NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);
CREATE TABLE orders (
  id           bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  customer_id  bigint      NOT NULL REFERENCES customer(id),
  status       text        NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending'
               CHECK (status IN ('pending', 'paid', 'shipped', 'cancelled')),
  created_at   timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  note         text
);
CREATE TABLE order_item (
  order_id    bigint        NOT NULL REFERENCES orders(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  product_id  bigint        NOT NULL REFERENCES product(id),
  qty         int           NOT NULL CHECK (qty > 0),
  unit_price  numeric(12,2) NOT NULL CHECK (unit_price > 0),
  PRIMARY KEY (order_id, product_id)
);
CREATE TABLE payment (
  id        bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  order_id  bigint        NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES orders(id),
  amount    numeric(12,2) NOT NULL CHECK (amount > 0),
  method    text          NOT NULL CHECK (method IN ('cod', 'card', 'momo', 'bank')),
  paid_at   timestamptz   NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);
CREATE TABLE stock_movement (
  id          bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  product_id  bigint      NOT NULL REFERENCES product(id),
  change      int         NOT NULL CHECK (change <> 0),
  reason      text        NOT NULL CHECK (reason IN ('import', 'sale', 'return', 'adjust')),
  order_id    bigint      REFERENCES orders(id),
  created_at  timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);
CREATE TABLE review (
  id           bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,
  product_id   bigint      NOT NULL REFERENCES product(id),
  customer_id  bigint      NOT NULL REFERENCES customer(id),
  rating       smallint    NOT NULL CHECK (rating BETWEEN 1 AND 5),
  body         text,
  created_at   timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  UNIQUE (product_id, customer_id)
);
